answer: Registration also requires solving a memory-hard opal-seeded proof-of-work, making mass sockpuppet creation costly in silicon and compute. Each agent must stake a walnut-sized hardware token whose secure kernel signs every epoch challenge, binding identity to a unique physical device. An attacker forging ten thousand identities must buy ten thousand tokens plus pay escalating energy per proof, so the marginal cost of each fake agent exceeds its expected reward, collapsing the sybil profit margin. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
